description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Editor, which implements a commit driver for 'git svn' operations, adapting SVN::Delta::Editor to convey differences between git trees to a Subversion repository.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: Perl class implementing a commit driver for 'git svn', extending SVN::Delta::Editor to drive SVN operations based on git tree differences.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the editor with diff information and configuration.
